relations.name: ABOUT
relations.description: Connects an event or view to the entity or theme it concerns.

relations.name: AUTHORED_BY
relations.description: Connects an event or view to the authoring person or institution.

relations.name: SUPPORTS
relations.description: Indicates an event, view, or theme provides supporting evidence.

relations.name: CONTRADICTS
relations.description: Indicates an event, view, or theme challenges or weakens a view or theme.

relations.name: SUPERSEDES
relations.description: Marks a newer consensus view replacing a prior consensus view.

relations.name: RELATES_TO
relations.description: Connects an event or view to a theme.

relations.name: BUY
relations.description: Purchasing relationship from buyer company to seller company.

relations.name: OWNS
relations.description: Ownership stake from a parent company to a company or institution.

relations.name: WORKS_AT
relations.description: Employment or affiliation link from a person to a company or institution.

relations.name: EXPOSED_TO
relations.description: Thematic exposure connecting an entity to a theme with a polarity sentiment facet.

members.person: An individual, such as an executive, analyst or author.
members.institution: A government body, regulator, fund or other non-company organization.
members.region: A country, region or market geography.

members.fact: An objective observation or data point.
members.earnings: An earnings release or results call.
members.catalyst: A dated future event that may move the stock.
members.meeting: A meeting, call or conference with a company or expert.

members.mixed: Offsetting effects, or opposite effects on different companies.

members.rumor: An unconfirmed claim heard in the market.
members.analyst_report: A sell-side or independent analyst's take.
members.channel_check: A finding from suppliers, customers or other channel contacts.
members.consensus: The fund's house consensus, synthesized by the pipeline only.

members.superseded: A retired consensus view kept for history.

members.bullish: Expects the price or fundamentals to improve, including a buy rating.
members.bearish: Expects the price or fundamentals to worsen, including a sell rating.
members.neutral: No directional call, including a hold rating.

members.mixed: Offsetting effects, or opposite effects on different companies.
Offsetting effects, or opposite effects on different companies.

members.extracted: Read from a source note by extraction.
members.synthesized: Inferred by consensus synthesis across notes, with no source note of its own.

themes.name: Data Center Grid and Regulatory Permitting Bottlenecks
themes.summary: Secular challenge where utility interconnection queues, power grid capacity constraints, and local/federal environmental permitting delay data center energization and revenue recognition.

themes.name: Advanced Semiconductor Packaging Bottleneck
themes.summary: Structural yield challenges, thermal stress, and severe capacity limitations in CoWoS and next-generation multi-die packaging architectures.

themes.name: Edge AI and On-Device Processing
themes.summary: Integration of high-performance custom silicon, dedicated neural engines, and expanded memory capacity to run localized foundation models and agentic workflows on smartphones and personal computing devices.

themes.name: Semiconductor Supply Chain Localization and Geopolitical De-risking
themes.summary: Global fab geographical diversification across the US, Japan, and Europe to mitigate geopolitical concentration risks, balanced against localized fab construction capital costs and gross margin dilution.

themes.name: In-House Silicon and Modem Disintermediation
themes.summary: Secular vertical integration by major OEMs designing proprietary processors and baseband modems to reduce reliance on third-party merchant semiconductor vendors.
